AGP 8.2+ Baseline Profile method wildcards require `->**(**)**` rather than bare `->*` to avoid profgen parser StringIndexOutOfBoundsException
gotchas: Do not commit hardcoded org.gradle.java.home in gradle.properties to ensure CI/CD runner compatibility across environments.
AGP expandArtProfileWildcards task throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException if baseline-prof.txt contains legacy `->*` wildcards; use `->**(**)**`.
GitHub Actions runner does not support 'secrets' context directly inside step 'if' conditions; use environment variables and evaluate inside the run script.
google-services.json and Keystore files (.jks) must always be kept out of git tracking and added to .gitignore.
Audio ducking requires AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN_TRANSIENT_MAY_DUCK; activeUtteranceCount must reach 0 before abandoning focus.
FusedLocationProviderClient.lastLocation can return null; getCurrentLocation with PRIORITY_HIGH_ACCURACY and cancellation tokens must be used.
Double tap / fast spam clicks can trigger duplicate navigation intents or rapid Google sign-in launches if not debounced.
